errors:
mfaCoverage: The term 'Get-ADServicePrincipal' is not recognized as a name of a cmdlet, function, script file, or executable program.
Check the spelling of the name, or if a path was included, verify that the path is correct and try again.

findings.label: Kerberoastable SPNs
findings.description: Privileged accounts with SPN (vulnerable to Kerberoast attack)
findings.recommendation: Remove SPNs from privileged accounts. Use gMSA for services.
findings.remediationCmd: Get-ADUser -Filter {Enabled -eq $true} -Properties ServicePrincipalName,MemberOf | Where {$_.ServicePrincipalName -and ($_.MemberOf -match 'Domain Admins')} | Select Name,SamAccountName,ServicePrincipalName

findings.label: Password Never Expires
findings.description: Enabled accounts with non-expiring passwords
findings.recommendation: Audit accounts. Service accounts should use MSA/gMSA. Regular accounts must comply with password policy. Score accommodates expected service account counts.
findings.remediationCmd: Get-ADUser -Filter {PasswordNeverExpires -eq $true -and Enabled -eq $true} | Select Name,SamAccountName | Export-Csv PwdNeverExpires.csv -NoTypeInformation

findings.label: Stale Admin Accounts
findings.description: Privileged accounts with no logon in 90+ days
findings.recommendation: Disable or remove stale admin accounts immediately. Implement quarterly reviews.
findings.remediationCmd:
$cutoff=(Get-Date).AddDays(-90)
Get-ADGroupMember 'Domain Admins' -Recursive | Where {$_.objectClass -eq 'user'} | Get-ADUser -Properties LastLogonDate | Where {$_.LastLogonDate -lt $cutoff} | Disable-ADAccount

findings.label: Dual-use Admin Accounts
findings.description: Domain Admins members not clearly designated as admin-only accounts
findings.recommendation: Provisional pass. This must be manually verified by an engineer. Implement Tiered Administration - admin accounts for admin tasks only, separate from daily-use accounts.
findings.remediationCmd: Get-ADGroupMember 'Domain Admins' -Recursive | Where {$_.objectClass -eq 'user'} | Get-ADUser -Properties Description | Select Name,SamAccountName,Description | Export-Csv DA_Audit.csv

findings.label: Protected Users Group
findings.description: Tier-0 admin accounts enrolled in the Protected Users security group
findings.recommendation: Add all Domain Admins, Enterprise Admins, Schema Admins to Protected Users group. Test compatibility first.
findings.remediationCmd: Get-ADGroupMember 'Domain Admins' -Recursive | Where {$_.objectClass -eq 'user'} | ForEach-Object { Add-ADGroupMember 'Protected Users' -Members $_.SamAccountName }

findings.label: Default Admin Account
findings.description: Built-in Administrator (RID-500) should be renamed and disabled
findings.recommendation: Rename the built-in Administrator account and disable it.

findings.label: Password Not Required (Legacy)
findings.description: Accounts with PASSWD_NOTREQD flag - can authenticate with blank password
findings.actualValue: 0 enabled accounts with PASSWD_NOTREQD flag. 0 disabled account(s) still carry the flag.
findings.recommendation: Clear the PASSWD_NOTREQD flag on all affected accounts.

findings.label: Admin Group Membership Bloat
findings.description: Excessive membership in Domain Admins, Enterprise Admins, Schema Admins groups
findings.actualValue: Domain Admins: 33 | Enterprise Admins: 1 | Schema Admins: 0
findings.recommendation: Reduce Domain Admins to minimum required accounts.
findings.remediationCmd: foreach ($grp in @('Domain Admins','Enterprise Admins','Schema Admins')) { Get-ADGroupMember $grp -Recursive | Where {$_.objectClass -eq 'user'} | Get-ADUser -Properties LastLogonDate | Select Name,SamAccountName,LastLogonDate }

findings.label: Service Account Audit (MSA/gMSA)
findings.description: Regular user accounts used as service accounts
findings.threshold: 0 regular user accounts used as service accounts
findings.actualValue: 31 regular-account service accounts detected | 2 gMSA accounts in use | Accounts: IWAM_GL-EXCH1, BigHand_SVC, SQLServices, IWAM_AG-MAIL1, IWAM_AG-MAIL2, IWAM_AG-BACKUP, IWAM_FLXSVR, ITSupport
findings.recommendation: Migrate service accounts to Group Managed Service Accounts (gMSA).

findings.label: Minimum Password Length
findings.description: Default Domain Password Policy minimum password length
findings.recommendation: Set minimum password length to 14+ characters via Default Domain Policy.

findings.label: Fine-Grained Password Policy
findings.description: Password Settings Objects (PSO) targeting admin accounts
findings.threshold: PSO applied to all admin groups
findings.recommendation: Create a stricter PSO for admin accounts (min 20 chars, lockout after 3 attempts).

findings.label: Reversible Encryption
findings.description: Accounts with AllowReversiblePasswordEncryption enabled
findings.recommendation: Disable reversible password encryption on all affected accounts immediately.

findings.label: AS-REP Roastable Accounts
findings.description: Accounts with Kerberos pre-authentication disabled
findings.recommendation: Enable Kerberos pre-authentication on all accounts.

findings.label: Password Age Compliance
findings.description: Enabled accounts with password unchanged for more than 365 days
findings.recommendation: Force password reset for non-compliant accounts. Enforce maximum password age policy.

findings.label: Account Lockout Policy
findings.description: Account lockout threshold configuration
findings.recommendation: Set lockout threshold to 5 attempts or fewer.

findings.label: Password Complexity Policy
findings.description: Password complexity requirement
findings.actualValue: Complexity: True | Min length: 14 | Max age: 180d
findings.recommendation: Enable password complexity. Set minimum length to 14+.

findings.label: Default Domain Policy Modified
findings.description: Default Domain Policy contains settings beyond Kerberos and password policy
findings.threshold: DDP used only for domain-wide password and Kerberos policy
findings.recommendation: Move non-password/Kerberos settings from DDP to dedicated GPOs.

findings.label: Orphaned GPOs
findings.description: GPOs with no OU or site links
findings.recommendation: Review and remove orphaned GPOs.
findings.remediationCmd: Get-GPO -All | Where {([xml](Get-GPOReport -Guid $_.Id -ReportType Xml)).GPO.LinksTo -eq $null} | Select DisplayName | Export-Csv OrphanedGPOs.csv

findings.label: Service Account Interactive Logon
findings.description: Service accounts should be restricted from interactive logon and RDP access to servers
findings.threshold: Service accounts denied interactive/RDP logon via GPO
findings.actualValue: Service accounts protected via GPO: Default Domain Controllers Policy, 2024 - Computer - Restrict RDP Access to DA accounts, 2026 - Computer  - Deny - Logon - Service - Acc and security group(s): Service Accounts, SvcAccounts-DenyLogon, SvcAccounts_Deny_Logon_Interactive
findings.recommendation: Create a GPO that denies 'Allow log on locally' and 'Allow log on through Remote Desktop Services' for service accounts or a dedicated security group containing service accounts.
findings.remediationCmd: New-ADGroup -Name 'ServiceAccounts-NoInteractiveLogon' -GroupScope Global; Set-GPPermissions -Name 'Deny Interactive Logon' -TargetGroup 'ServiceAccounts-NoInteractiveLogon' -Permission Deny

findings.label: LAPS Deployment
findings.description: Local Administrator Password Solution - check is provisional; LAPS may be deployed via O365/Intune without AD schema attributes
findings.actualValue: LAPS methods detected: Intune MDM (proxy). 535 Win10/11 devices - cloud LAPS policy possible (proxy indicator)
findings.recommendation: Provisional pass. This must be manually verified by an engineer. LAPS can be deployed from O365/Intune without extending the local AD schema. Verify LAPS policy via Intune or confirm AD schema extension for on-prem LAPS.
findings.remediationCmd: On-Prem: Import-Module AdmPwd.PS; Update-AdmPwdADSchema | Azure: Configure LAPS policy in Intune

findings.label: SMBv1 Disabled
findings.description: SMBv1 protocol enabled on domain controllers (EternalBlue/WannaCry risk)
findings.recommendation: Disable SMBv1 via GPO and directly on all servers.

findings.label: NTLMv1 Disabled
findings.description: LAN Manager Authentication Level should be 5 (NTLMv2 only)
findings.recommendation: Set LmCompatibilityLevel to 5 via GPO under Security Options.

findings.label: Advanced Audit Policy
findings.description: Advanced Audit Policy configured across all 9 Windows audit categories
findings.recommendation: Enable all Advanced Audit Policy categories via GPO using CIS Benchmark Level 1.
findings.remediationCmd:
$cats=@('Account Logon','Account Management','Logon/Logoff','Object Access','Policy Change','Privilege Use','System')
foreach ($c in $cats) { auditpol /set /category:"$c" /success:enable /failure:enable }

findings.label: AppLocker / WDAC
findings.description: Application control policy deployment
findings.threshold: Applied to all servers and privileged workstations
findings.recommendation: Deploy AppLocker in audit mode first, then enforce. WDAC preferred for newer OS.
findings.remediationCmd:
Set-Service AppIDSvc -StartupType Automatic
Start-Service AppIDSvc
Get-AppLockerPolicy -Effective | Format-List

findings.label: GPO WMI Filter Health
findings.description: GPOs with broken WMI filter references
findings.threshold: 0 GPOs with broken WMI filter references
findings.actualValue: 1 GPOs use WMI filters | 0 broken filter links
findings.recommendation: Remove broken WMI filter links from affected GPOs.

findings.label: GPO Enforce / Block Inheritance
findings.description: OUs with Block Inheritance active
findings.recommendation: Document all OUs with Block Inheritance.

findings.label: FSMO Role Health
findings.description: All 5 FSMO role holders responding and reachable
findings.recommendation: Ensure all FSMO holders are online and healthy.

findings.label: AD Replication Errors
findings.description: Active Directory replication error count (repadmin /replsummary)
findings.recommendation: Run repadmin /replsummary and repadmin /showrepl to identify failing partners.

findings.label: DFSR Replication (SYSVOL)
findings.description: SYSVOL replication mechanism - DFSR is modern, FRS is deprecated
findings.recommendation: Migrate from FRS to DFSR using dfsrmig tool.

findings.label: Domain/Forest Functional Level
findings.description: AD Domain and Forest functional level
findings.recommendation: Upgrade functional level to 2016+ after ensuring all DCs are on 2016+.

findings.label: DC OS Version / EOL Check
findings.description: Domain Controllers running end-of-life Windows Server versions
findings.threshold: All DCs on Windows Server 2016 or newer
findings.recommendation: Upgrade or replace EOL DCs immediately.
findings.remediationCmd: Get-ADDomainController -Filter * | ForEach-Object { Get-ADComputer $_.Name -Properties OperatingSystem } | Select-Object Name,OperatingSystem | Sort-Object OperatingSystem

findings.label: DNS Scavenging
findings.description: DNS aging and scavenging enabled on primary forward lookup zones
findings.threshold: All primary zones with aging enabled
findings.recommendation: Enable aging on all AD-integrated zones. Set 7-day no-refresh, 7-day refresh intervals.

findings.label: NTP Time Synchronisation
findings.description: Domain time synchronisation hierarchy
findings.threshold: PDC Emulator syncing to external NTP
findings.actualValue: Source: VM IC Time Synchronization Provider | NtpServer configured: True
findings.recommendation: Configure PDC Emulator to sync to external NTP (pool.ntp.org).

findings.label: Tombstone Lifetime
findings.description: AD tombstone lifetime - affects backup restore validity
findings.recommendation: Set tombstone lifetime to 180 days.

findings.label: DC Redundancy
findings.description: Number of domain controllers and their AD site distribution
findings.actualValue: 5 DCs across 5 AD sites. | Sites: ALIP-DC01[Ipswich] | ALFH-DC01[Fornham] | ALCA-DC01[Cambridge] | ALAZ-DC01[Azure] | ALNO-DC01[Norwich]
findings.recommendation: Minimum 2 DCs required. Best practice: 3+ DCs across 2+ sites.

findings.label: DNS Zone Sync
findings.description: DNS zone presence and SOA serial consistency across DNS DCs
findings.threshold: All zones present on all DNS DCs
findings.actualValue: All sonicwall.com axa.com ashtonkcjclients.co.uk TrustAnchors ashtonkcjtest2.co.uk internal.ashtongraham.co.uk privatelink.file.core.windows.net ashtonslegal.co.uk ashtonkcj.co.uk zones in sync across 5 DNS DCs.
findings.recommendation: Ensure all DCs hosting DNS have identical zone sets.

findings.label: DC NIC DNS Configuration
findings.description: DC network adapter DNS server settings audited against best practices
findings.threshold: No loopback/public DNS as primary, min 2 entries
findings.recommendation: Primary DNS should be another DC's IP. Never use public DNS on DCs.

findings.label: DCDiag Health Check
findings.description: dcdiag quick DC health validation
findings.recommendation: Investigate any dcdiag failures immediately.

findings.label: SYSVOL / NETLOGON Shares
findings.description: SYSVOL and NETLOGON share accessibility on all DCs
findings.threshold: Both SYSVOL and NETLOGON accessible on all DCs
findings.recommendation: SYSVOL/NETLOGON inaccessible means GPOs are not delivered.

findings.label: Stale Computer Accounts
findings.description: Enabled computer accounts with no logon in 90+ days
findings.recommendation: Disable then delete stale computer accounts after 30-day grace period.

findings.label: Duplicate SPNs
findings.description: Duplicate Service Principal Names in AD
findings.recommendation: Run 'setspn -X -F' to identify. Remove duplicates from non-owner accounts.

findings.label: Inactive User Accounts
findings.description: Enabled user accounts with no logon in 60+ days
findings.recommendation: Implement automated 60-day inactivity policy. Notify manager, disable, delete after 30-day hold.

findings.label: Guest Account Secured
findings.description: Built-in Guest (RID-501) account should be disabled and optionally renamed
findings.threshold: Disabled and ideally renamed from default 'Guest'
findings.actualValue: Name: AshtonsUser, Enabled: False | Status: Disabled, Renamed (AshtonsUser)
findings.recommendation: Disable and rename the Guest account. Renaming prevents automated attacks targeting default account names.

findings.label: KRBTGT Password Age
findings.description: Age of the KRBTGT account password - Golden Ticket mitigation
findings.recommendation: Reset KRBTGT password TWICE (10+ hours apart) every 180 days.

findings.label: Empty Organisational Units
findings.description: OUs with no child objects
findings.recommendation: Review empty OUs and remove if no longer needed.

findings.label: AdminSDHolder Orphaned Accounts
findings.description: Accounts with AdminCount=1 residue but no longer members of any privileged group
findings.actualValue: 59 account(s) with AdminCount=1 but not in any privileged group
findings.recommendation: Clear AdminCount=1 on accounts no longer in privileged groups.
findings.remediationCmd: Get-ADUser -Filter {AdminCount -eq 1} -Properties AdminCount,MemberOf | Where-Object { -not ($_.MemberOf -match 'Domain Admins|Enterprise Admins|Schema Admins|Administrators') } | Select Name,SamAccountName

findings.label: Security Event Log Size
findings.description: Maximum Security event log size on domain controllers
findings.threshold: 600MB - 1.2GB with archiving and backup in place
findings.recommendation: Optimal range is 600MB-1.2GB with auto-archive enabled. Balance retention with storage and backup capacity.

findings.label: Log Retention Policy
findings.description: Security event log retention and archiving configuration
findings.threshold: AutoBackup or SIEM forwarding; 90+ day retention
findings.recommendation: Enable auto-archive for Security logs. Forward to SIEM for 90-day minimum retention.

findings.label: SIEM / Log Forwarding
findings.description: Windows Event Forwarding or SIEM agent for centralised log collection (informational check)
findings.threshold: SIEM forwarding recommended but not critical for AD security score
findings.actualValue: No WEF or SIEM forwarding detected (informational - consider deploying)
findings.recommendation: Consider deploying WEF or SIEM agent for enhanced log retention and correlation. Not required for AD security baseline.

findings.label: AV / Defender Coverage
findings.description: Windows Defender/AV active on domain controllers with real-time monitoring
findings.threshold: Running with real-time protection on all DCs
findings.actualValue: Engine: Windows Defender | Running: True | Real-time: True | Mode: Normal
findings.recommendation: Ensure Defender/AV runs on all DCs with real-time protection. Add AD exclusions per KB822158.

findings.label: GPO Certificate Expiry
findings.description: Certificates deployed via GPO  expiry audit
findings.threshold: No expired certs in GPO distribution
findings.recommendation: Review certificate-deploying GPOs before expiry.
findings.remediationCmd: Get-GPO -All | ForEach-Object { $rpt = Get-GPOReport -Guid $_.Id -ReportType Xml; if ($rpt -match 'PublicKeyPolicies') { Write-Host $_.DisplayName } }

findings.label: Legacy / EOL Operating Systems
findings.description: End-of-life OS detection across all domain computers
findings.recommendation: EOL servers require L4 engagement. Upgrade EOL workstations to Windows 11.

findings.label: Server AV / EDR Coverage
findings.description: Antivirus and EDR coverage across domain-joined servers
findings.recommendation: Deploy AV/EDR to ALL servers. Unprotected servers are highest-risk assets.
findings.remediationCmd: Get-ADComputer -Filter {OperatingSystem -like '*Server*'} | ForEach-Object { try { Invoke-Command -ComputerName $_.Name -ScriptBlock { Get-Service -Name WinDefend } -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } catch {} }

findings.label: Server Uptime / Reboot Required
findings.description: Servers requiring reboot due to high uptime (excludes Hyper-V hosts)
findings.actualValue: Servers needing reboot: 0 / 37 (0%) | Checked: 0 | Exempt Hyper-V: 26 | Critical(60d+): 0 | High(30d+): 0 | Medium(14d+): 0 | Unreachable: 11
findings.recommendation: Reboot servers with high uptime. Hyper-V hosts are exempt (typically rebooted every 2-3 months).
findings.remediationCmd: Get-ADComputer -Filter {OperatingSystem -like '*Server*'} -Properties LastLogonDate | ForEach-Object { $wmi = Get-WmiObject -ComputerName $_.Name -Class Win32_OperatingSystem -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($wmi) { $days = ((Get-Date) - ($wmi.ConvertToDateTime($wmi.LastBootUpTime))).Days; if ($days -gt 14) { $_.Name + ' - ' + $days + ' days' } } }

findings.label: Windows Update / Patching Status
findings.description: Servers with overdue Windows updates (excludes Hyper-V hosts)
findings.actualValue: Servers needing updates: 4 / 37 (10.8%) | Checked: 7 | Exempt Hyper-V: 27 | Critical(30d+): 0 | High(21d+): 0 | Medium(14d+): 4 | Unreachable: 0
findings.recommendation: Deploy pending Windows updates. Hyper-V hosts are exempt from strict checks (typically patched on host reboot schedule).
findings.remediationCmd: Get-ADComputer -Filter {OperatingSystem -like '*Server*'} | ForEach-Object { try { $sessions = New-PSSession -ComputerName $_.Name -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($sessions) { $lastUpdate = Invoke-Command -Session $sessions -ScriptBlock { try { $session = New-Object -ComObject Microsoft.Update.Session; $searcher = $session.CreateUpdateSearcher(); $history = $searcher.QueryHistory(0,1) | Select-Object -First 1; if ($history) { $history.Date } } catch {} }; Remove-PSSession $sessions } } catch {} }

findings.label: Windows Update Compliance
findings.description: Server patch compliance - days since last Windows Update applied
findings.recommendation: Servers >30 days without patches require immediate attention.

findings.label: RDP Network Level Authentication
findings.description: NLA requires authentication before RDP session opens
findings.threshold: NLA enabled on all DCs and servers
findings.recommendation: Enable NLA on all servers especially DCs.
